contract.interface:
For n two-level emitters, Q=sum_i q_i and supplied classical finite-precision C in C^(r x n), collective photon jumps are L_mu=sum_i c_mu,i sigma_i^-. The model includes a supplied commuting diagonal H0=sum_i d_i q_i+sum_ij u_ij q_i q_j, exchange Hamiltonian, coherent drives Omega_i, local pumps sqrt(p_i)sigma_i^+ and dephasing sqrt(kappa_i)Z_i. Inhomogeneous coefficients and arbitrary connectivity are allowed and charged; no permutation symmetry is assumed. Input support is Q<=k0; k0=n allows an unrestricted unknown state entangled with a reference. Output is the full Markovian channel to diamond error epsilon and specified observables, not a laboratory-validated microscopic model.

Writing omega=sum|Omega_i|, p*=sum p_i and kappa*=sum kappa_i, the source derives E exp(theta J_T)<=exp[theta k0+T(2sinh(theta/2)omega+(exp(theta)-1)kappa*+(exp(2theta)-1)p*)] for theta>0. J counts all photon, pump and the specified Z-dephasing events. A tilted positive state weighted by exp(theta Q) cancels collective lowering in its generator; it is a proof device, not an assumed quantum oracle. With baromega=sum(|Re Omega_i|+|Im Omega_i|), R=ceil(k0+2T baromega+2T kappa*+7T p*+log(32/epsilon)) bounds overflow probability by epsilon/32 uniformly. An absorbing flag retains all probability; the channel penalty is at most twice overflow probability. No survival renormalization or rare-event postselection is used. The budget is representation-specific, not invariant under arbitrary Lindblad gauge changes.

The explicit factor A=sum_i |i> tensor sigma_i^- has A^dagger A=Q. A/sqrt(n) is constructed by reversible Hamming-weight arithmetic, an occupied-index selection and cleanup with O(n poly(b)) gates, including the vacuum failure branch and a globally normalized unitary. Coefficient row-state preparation implements C/||C||_F in O(rn poly(b)) gates without QRAM; it does not receive a free data oracle. The emitter label must be erased coherently after combining C with A; retaining it destroys collective interference and dark states. Physical mode labels remain. The stacked normalization is g^2=n||C||_F^2+p*+kappa*. Frobenius rather than spectral normalization incurs up to sqrt(r) in this jump scale. H0 phases cost O((n+|E0|)poly(b)); the remaining Pauli LCU has h=sum_exchange(|Re J_ij|+|Im J_ij|)+baromega. The same commuting interaction-picture improvement is granted to the comparison algorithm.

This proposed consequence depends explicitly on the unreviewed N701 loss-complete first-event implementation, not merely its conservation identity. Using a power-of-two W between R+1 and 2(R+1), windows T/W, coherent suffix selectors and padded identity calls, at most W+R first-event operations implement a fixed isometry with an inverse. The claimed query count is O-tilde(R+1+g sqrt(T(R+1))+hT). Binary grid indices and arithmetic charge log(M), not an uncharged explicit list of M time slices. With lambda0=sum|d_i|+sum|u_ij|, a=g^2/2+h and D=a^2+2lambda0(g^2+h), the source supplies a Lipschitz/discretization and hybrid-error budget; exact constants and the inherited compiler remain review obligations. Quantum workspace is O(n+(R+1)poly(b)) when all event records are kept coherently.

D_in=rn+n+|E0|+|Eex| gives G_sim=O(D_in poly(b)[R+1+g sqrt(T(R+1))+hT]); reading B0-bit coefficients costs Omega(D_in B0), and preprocessing O(D_in poly(b)). Coherent preparation and inverse cost C_in and a bounded effect 0<=F<=I costs C_F. Estimating that effect to additive delta with failure zeta claims O-tilde(P_pre+(G_sim+C_in+C_F)delta^-1 log(1/zeta)), with simulation error O(delta). Copies-only access instead costs delta^-2 shots. Photon mode/time-bin counters and rB log(R+1) storage are charged separately. Simultaneous pair-Pauli estimates use O(delta^-2 log(n/zeta)) shots and O(n^2) classical processing per shot, storage and output; no claim writes an n^2 correlation map for free.

For fixed r, bounded-degree diagonal/exchange graphs, per-emitter collective couplings of order gamma, pump/drive/dephasing rates O(gamma), and T=Theta(1/gamma), the source obtains ||C||_F^2=Theta(gamma n), g^2=Theta(gamma n^2), hT=O(n), R=O(n+log(1/epsilon)). It proposes O-tilde(n^(5/2)) logical gates versus an instantiated general-algorithm upper bound O-tilde(n^3), using identical explicit oracles and interaction picture. One bounded observable adds delta^-1 with coherent access, delta^-2 with copies. This is an improved pair of upper bounds in a specified model; it proves no lower-bound separation or universal advantage over specialized classical/quantum algorithms. The Dicke collective rate Theta(gamma n^2) is real; for the early flash T=Theta(1/(gamma n)) the bounds can be comparable. No certified stationarity time follows.

For ||C-C'||_F<=e_C, ||H-H'||<=e_H and total pump/dephasing rate errors e_p,e_kappa, the source states diamond distance <=T(2e_H+4ns e_C+2n e_C^2+2e_p+2e_kappa), s=||C||_F. Acquiring/calibrating coefficients and validating the Markov approximation remain external tasks. Strong drive/pumping can eliminate the advantage; hT remains, symmetric/solvable subclasses may be easier, and retardation, non-Markovian dynamics and fault-tolerance overhead are outside the logical-gate result. An observable of norm S with absolute error delta_abs charges delta=delta_abs/S. Tiny probabilities and normalized rare outputs have no free relative accuracy. Reported small-system diagnostics do not establish independent correctness, priority, executed circuitry or technological readiness.
